chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era ch. 539: Ji Ning Breaks Through & Silent Assassination of True Immortal Baiji
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning achieves Pure Yang True Immortal in secret, gains eighty percent control of the Xingtian Formation, and kills True Immortal Baiji in a single, devastating strike—the first major death of the Grand Xia war.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 539 – Pure Yang Breakthrough & First True Immortal Death
og_description: Inside the Xingtian Formation, Ji Ning transforms into a Pure Yang True Immortal, shattering Baiji’s golden core with an assassination strike that changes the battlefield.
twitter_title: Desolate Era 539 – Ji Ning’s Silent Power Play
twitter_description: The Xia Emperor orders retreat, Baiji gloats—then Ji Ning, now Pure Yang, obliterates him from hiding. The war’s first True Immortal death.

lore_anchors.definition: A Ki Refining Realm above Celestial Immortal: the golden core becomes pure yang, granting vastly superior magic power and qualitative life-form transformation.

The five elemental Daos (Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth) a Celestial Immortal must master to enable the golden core’s transformation into Pure Yang; linking to the Five Elements Source provides external power.

A massive war formation requiring 100,000 Loose Immortals as a foundation and 1,000 Celestial Immortals as a framework, manifesting a temporary divine spirit of god-tier durability; bestowed by Xingtian the True God.

A formless, metaphysical power derived from a cultivator’s will and Dao‑heart, distinct from Ki or Divine Power; here at the third and perfect level, Ji Ning uses it to gain unprecedented control over the formation.
Nine Pure Yang supreme-grade flying swords, each harboring a sword-spirit in the form of a golden monk-like child; created by the Buddha Ananda.
A mobile fortress employed by the Grand Xia Emperor, used to evacuate troops during a retreat.
A battle formation composed of 1,000 Celestial Immortals and 100,000 Loose Immortals, manifesting as a massive, powerful dragon-like creature.
A hidden, cold strike technique used by Ji Ning inside the Xingtian Formation; it shattered True Immortal Baiji’s Pure Yang golden core before he could react.
